lines.cap: She said, do whatever you want. He believed her. That was his first mistake.
lines.say: She said, do whatever you want. He believed her. That was his first mistake.

lines.cap: So, what do you want for dinner?
lines.say: So, what do you want for dinner?

lines.cap: If he orders pizza, it's over.
lines.say: If he orders pizza, it's over.
lines.bubble: IF HE ORDERS PIZZA… IT'S OVER.

lines.cap: Oh no. I've seen this since eighteen twenty four.
lines.say: Oh no. I've seen this since eighteen twenty four.

lines.cap: Thirty minutes later, the pizza arrives. Silence.
lines.say: Thirty minutes later, the pizza arrives. Silence.

lines.cap: I wanted pizza. I just wanted you to guess.
lines.say: I wanted pizza. I just wanted you to guess.
lines.bubble: I WANTED PIZZA. YOU HAD TO GUESS.

lines.cap: Tag the one who always says, do whatever you want. Because she said, do whatever you want.
lines.say: Tag the one who always says, do whatever you want. Because she said, do whatever you want.
